title: S1: language seam and command contract for Python (ADR 0008)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 (a2) slice S1: a LanguageIndexer seam over the TypeScript indexer with no behaviour change for TypeScript-only repositories, language detection, --language, one language per run, coverage-line entry for languages not indexed, additive contract fields recorded in ADR 0002. No Python indexer and no new dependency.

acceptanceCriteria.text: TypeScript-only output is byte-identical to dev, proven by a test that fails if it changes
--language and detection select one language per run; a language not indexed is named with its file count in the coverage line; an unregistered language is a clear usage error, never a silent empty
Additive fields are declared in help --json and recorded in ADR 0002
bun run check and lore check are green

implementationNotes: S1 implementation 2baa698 (rules commit 6176810, tracker 33f2004); Opus review at 33f2004 returned CHANGES (B1-B4 + should-fix), follow-up commit on this branch. Scope note (B2): --ref and code-map still build TypeScript only through indexSnapshot (src/snapshot.ts), not through the LanguageIndexer seam; S7 owns wiring Python into them. The --ref path reports notIndexed from the ref's tree listing. Python-only repository keeps dev's exit 3 not_found, naming python and its file count, until S7 registers Python indexing (reviewer ruling B1). AC2 reading (B4): the help --json manifest has no slot for output fields, so only the --language flag is declared there; language and notIndexed are recorded in the ADR 0002 amendment and the README, and AC2 is not checked as written. ADR 0008 is not on origin/dev at this SHA (merge-order dependency on docs/GCLI-68-adr-0008-native-python); the ADR 0002 amendment cites it in prose. Verified by the worker under the pinned bun 1.4.2 at 33f2004: bun run check 282 pass, 0 fail; lore check 0/0.
